class InterpolationMissingOptionRealLookupTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test InterpolationMissingOptionError obtained through real ConfigParser.get
    calls under BasicInterpolation and ExtendedInterpolation.

    Covers shallow copy, deep copy, and every available pickle protocol.
    Also exercises raw=True retrieval and successful lookup after the
    referenced setting is supplied.
    """

    def _basic_missing(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[Paths]",
            "home_dir = /Users",
            "my_dir = %(home_dir_missing)s/lumberjack",
        ]))
        try:
            parser.get("Paths", "my_dir")
        except configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError as e:
            return e, parser
        self.fail("Expected InterpolationMissingOptionError (basic)")

    def _extended_missing(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[Paths]",
            "home_dir = /Users",
            "my_dir = ${home_dir_missing}/lumberjack",
        ]))
        try:
            parser.get("Paths", "my_dir")
        except configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError as e:
            return e, parser
        self.fail("Expected InterpolationMissingOptionError (extended)")

    def _extended_cross_section_missing(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[SectionA]",
            "target = ${SectionB:missing_option}",
            "",
            "[SectionB]",
            "other = value",
        ]))
        try:
            parser.get("SectionA", "target")
        except configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError as e:
            return e, parser
        self.fail("Expected InterpolationMissingOptionError (cross-section)")

    def test_basic_exception_attributes(self):
        e, parser = self._basic_missing()
        self.assertIs(type(e), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(e.option, "my_dir")
        self.assertEqual(e.section, "Paths")
        self.assertEqual(e.reference, "home_dir_missing")
        self.assertEqual(e.rawval, "%(home_dir_missing)s/lumberjack")
        # diagnostic text includes the failing reference
        self.assertIn("home_dir_missing", str(e))

    def test_extended_exception_attributes(self):
        e, parser = self._extended_missing()
        self.assertIs(type(e), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(e.option, "my_dir")
        self.assertEqual(e.section, "Paths")
        self.assertEqual(e.reference, "home_dir_missing")
        self.assertEqual(e.rawval, "${home_dir_missing}/lumberjack")
        self.assertIn("home_dir_missing", str(e))

    def test_extended_cross_section_attributes(self):
        e, parser = self._extended_cross_section_missing()
        self.assertIs(type(e), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(e.option, "target")
        self.assertEqual(e.section, "SectionA")
        self.assertEqual(e.reference, "SectionB:missing_option")
        self.assertEqual(e.rawval, "${SectionB:missing_option}")
        self.assertIn("missing_option", str(e))

    def test_raw_retrieval_basic(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[Paths]",
            "home_dir = /Users",
            "my_dir = %(home_dir_missing)s/lumberjack",
        ]))
        raw_val = parser.get("Paths", "my_dir", raw=True)
        self.assertEqual(raw_val, "%(home_dir_missing)s/lumberjack")

    def test_raw_retrieval_extended(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[Paths]",
            "home_dir = /Users",
            "my_dir = ${home_dir_missing}/lumberjack",
        ]))
        raw_val = parser.get("Paths", "my_dir", raw=True)
        self.assertEqual(raw_val, "${home_dir_missing}/lumberjack")

    def test_successful_after_adding_basic(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[Paths]",
            "home_dir = /Users",
            "my_dir = %(home_dir_missing)s/lumberjack",
        ]))
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError):
            parser.get("Paths", "my_dir")
        parser.set("Paths", "home_dir_missing", "/Missing")
        self.assertEqual(
            parser.get("Paths", "my_dir"), "/Missing/lumberjack")

    def test_successful_after_adding_extended(self):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(
            interpolation=configparser.ExtendedInterpolation())
        parser.read_string("\n".join([
            "[Paths]",
            "home_dir = /Users",
            "my_dir = ${home_dir_missing}/lumberjack",
        ]))
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError):
            parser.get("Paths", "my_dir")
        parser.set("Paths", "home_dir_missing", "/Missing")
        self.assertEqual(
            parser.get("Paths", "my_dir"), "/Missing/lumberjack")

    def _check_copy(self, e):
        import copy
        e2 = copy.copy(e)
        self.assertIs(type(e2), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(e2.args, e.args)
        self.assertEqual(e2.option, e.option)
        self.assertEqual(e2.section, e.section)
        self.assertEqual(e2.reference, e.reference)
        self.assertEqual(e2.message, e.message)
        self.assertEqual(repr(e2), repr(e))

    def _check_deepcopy(self, e):
        import copy
        e2 = copy.deepcopy(e)
        self.assertIs(type(e2), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
        self.assertEqual(e2.args, e.args)
        self.assertEqual(e2.option, e.option)
        self.assertEqual(e2.section, e.section)
        self.assertEqual(e2.reference, e.reference)
        self.assertEqual(e2.message, e.message)
        self.assertEqual(repr(e2), repr(e))

    def _check_pickle(self, e):
        import pickle
        for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
            with self.subTest(proto=proto):
                pickled = pickle.dumps(e, proto)
                e2 = pickle.loads(pickled)
                self.assertIs(
                    type(e2), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
                self.assertEqual(e2.args, e.args)
                self.assertEqual(e2.option, e.option)
                self.assertEqual(e2.section, e.section)
                self.assertEqual(e2.reference, e.reference)
                self.assertEqual(e2.message, e.message)
                self.assertEqual(repr(e2), repr(e))

    def test_copy_basic(self):
        e, _ = self._basic_missing()
        self._check_copy(e)

    def test_deepcopy_basic(self):
        e, _ = self._basic_missing()
        self._check_deepcopy(e)

    def test_pickle_basic(self):
        e, _ = self._basic_missing()
        self._check_pickle(e)

    def test_copy_extended(self):
        e, _ = self._extended_missing()
        self._check_copy(e)

    def test_deepcopy_extended(self):
        e, _ = self._extended_missing()
        self._check_deepcopy(e)

    def test_pickle_extended(self):
        e, _ = self._extended_missing()
        self._check_pickle(e)


class MiscTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def test__all__(self):
        support.check__all__(self, configparser, not_exported={"Error"})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
